data.gender_notes: Tanish is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tanish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘tan’ meaning ‘to give’ and ‘ish’ meaning ‘lord’ or ‘god’. This name signifies the bestowal of grace or blessing from the divine. It is a name that embodies the essence of a gift or a blessing from the heavens. The name Tanish carries the meaning “Gift, Grace, Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Tanish usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Tanish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace, Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tanish total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
